facts.business: CERA Sanitaryware Limited manufactures and sells sanitaryware and faucetware building products in India.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is expected to grow in the range of 18–20% during the current financial year, building on the momentum of H2 FY25-26.

key_risks: Moderation in discretionary household spending due to evolving economic realities and lifestyle choices
Purchase deferral by first-time home builders and mid-income renovators
Supply chain disruptions and input cost volatility
Dependence on raw materials like clay sourced from specific regions
Regulatory and compliance risks including EPR and environmental norms
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not made any loans or advances in the nature of loans to Promoters, Directors, KMP's and the related parties which are outstanding as at the end of the current year and previous year.
